summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39 (adopt generated OpenAPI client + solver parity corpus). Committed: (1) SolverParityCorpusTests.swift — a corpus-driven parity harness over WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and CompositionSolver that loads solver_parity_corpus.json (23 cases: 14 score, 9 selection) and asserts exact expected outcomes including dyadic-exact tie cases (earliest palette entry wins, not lowest id), candidate/target exclusions, measured-zero vs missing, and weight handling (zero-weight channels never exclude; weight flips flip winners); expected values are computed by an independent Python reference implementation (generate_solver_parity_corpus.py) and re-verified end-to-end a second time (24 score/cell assertions, 0 mismatches). (2) PaletteAPIClientContractTests.swift — 10-test behavioral safety net pinning GET /api/v1/colors?printer_profile_id=N and GET /api/v1/printer_profiles request shape, trimmed bearer tokens, 401/badStatus/malformedResponse mapping, and snake_case envelope decoding so the generated-client migration cannot change observable behavior. (3) OpenAPIClientMigrationTests.swift — intentionally red contract tests requiring swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime in Package.swift and the /api/v1 OpenAPI document at a conventional path (red confirmed: neither exists at PR head). (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md and docs/openapi-client-contract.md. BLOCKER: no Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container and CI is macOS-only, so swift test could not be executed here — all Swift tests are written but not run (per-criterion statuses below record this); corpus JSON validated with jq + Python, Swift files passed delimiter/structure checks but no compiler check was possible.
